Register a pytree node class with key paths

Source: R/tree_util.R
register_pytree_with_keys.Rd

Port of jax.tree_util.register_pytree_with_keys: like register_pytree_node(), with a flatten function that also names each child, so that tree_flatten_with_path() reports these keys.

Usage

register_pytree_with_keys(
  nodetype,
  flatten_with_keys,
  unflatten_func,
  flatten_func = NULL
)

Arguments

nodetype

Class name.

flatten_with_keys

Function of a node returning list(children = <list of list(key, child) pairs>, aux = <any>).

unflatten_func

Function of (aux, children) returning a node.

flatten_func

Optional faster flatten function returning list(children, aux) with the same children and aux.

Value

nodetype, invisibly.
